lines.en: Touching the ground gently with tentacles.

lines.zh: 乘着上升气流飘过浮岛
lines.en: It rides the updraft across a floating island.

lines.zh: 脚掌踩在云苔上，软软的
lines.en: Its feet sink softly into the cloud moss.

lines.zh: 它绕着岛缘走，避开空处
lines.en: It walks the isle's rim, avoiding the gaps.

lines.zh: 长尾一摆，转向另一片草地
lines.en: A swing of its long tail turns it to another meadow.

lines.zh: 走走停停，嗅着风来的方向
lines.en: It wanders, sniffing where the wind comes from.

lines.zh: 它低头舔了舔石上的露水
lines.en: It bends to lick dew off the stone.
Stands quietly in the shade of the tree.
Closes eyes to enjoy the peace.
Tentacles sway gently in the breeze.

lines.zh: 静静地倾听森林的声音。
lines.en: Listens quietly to the forest sounds.

lines.zh: 卧在苔上，尾巴搭着身子
lines.en: It lies on the moss, tail over its body.

lines.zh: 它仰头看着岛外的云海
lines.en: It looks up at the sea of clouds beyond the isle.

lines.zh: 耳朵抖了抖，赶走一只虫
lines.en: Its ear flicks, shooing a bug away.

lines.zh: 风一变，它就换个方向站着
lines.en: When the wind shifts, it turns to face it.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子埋进柔软的苔里
lines.en: It buries its nose in the soft moss.
Light dust settles on its back; it does not move.

lines.zh: 我的触手在空气里打着手势。
lines.en: My tendrils make gestures in the air.
Gently moves tentacles as a sign.

lines.zh: 你身上带着天境的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of the Aether.
Taps the player gently with a tentacle.
Traces the player with its gaze.
Approaches the player in a friendly manner.

lines.zh: 我的触手先碰碰你的手。
lines.en: My tendrils test your hand first.
It tilts its head at your pack.

lines.zh: 你身上那块金片吸引了我！
lines.en: That gold piece on you attracts me!

lines.zh: 这些树叶很适合我胃口。
这片草地看起来很舒服。

lines.en: The distant flower scent lures me.
It's easier to find food in the sun.

lines.zh: 那包里的苔藓闻着真香
lines.en: The moss in that pack smells good.

lines.zh: 给我一把光尘，我就跟你走
lines.en: Give me a handful of light dust and I'll follow.
The fruit in your hand is sweeter than flowers.

lines.zh: 风里有熟透的菌子气味
lines.en: The wind carries the smell of ripe mushrooms.
Put the grass down and I'll come closer.

lines.zh: 我只想再吃一口那朵花
lines.en: I just want one more bite of that flower.

lines.zh: 你的体型挡住了我的路。

lines.en: I was injured after the collision.

lines.zh: 我的身体和你的身体碰撞。
我们的触须交错在一起。
天境的水晶光下，我等你。
lines.en: Under Aether crystal light, I wait for you.
My tendrils search for a mate.

lines.zh: 我的触须缠绕在它的身上。
我的触须和它的触须交织。
交配后我变得更有活力。

lines.en: Percipitus gently lands among the grasses.
The sound of Percipitus munching leaves.
Percipitus lightly leaps to a branch.

lines.zh: Percipitus的羽毛在阳光下熠熠生辉。
lines.en: Percipitus's feathers shine in the sunlight.
Percipitus's feathers softly touch the ground.
Percipitus notices movement in the distance.
Percipitus makes a low call to its prey.

lines.zh: Percipitus的双眼锐利地盯着猎物。
lines.en: Percipitus's eyes fix on its prey.
Percipitus prepares to leap at its prey.
Percipitus locks onto its prey's position.
Percipitus's feathers flutter in the wind.
Percipitus waits for its prey to appear.

lines.zh: Percipitus的喙精准地捕捉到猎物。
lines.en: Percipitus's beak precisely seizes its prey.
Percipitus uses its tongue to wrap its prey.
Percipitus's sharp claws pierce its prey.
Percipitus pecks at its prey with its sharp beak.
Percipitus's feelers wrap around its prey.
Percipitus's sharp teeth crunch its prey.

lines.zh: Percipitus的触角感知猎物的位置。
lines.en: Percipitus's antennae sense its prey's position.
Percipitus's claws tear through its prey.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，锋利的牙齿磨擦着。
一跃而起，锋爪划过空气。
lines.en: Leaping, claws slicing through the air.
Maw opens wide, predator closing in.

lines.zh: 用角顶撞，试图将猎物制服。
lines.en: Butt with horn, trying to subdue prey.

lines.zh: 跳跃攻击，精准击中目标。

lines.en: Swing horns, trying to knock down.
Crawl out of the cave slowly.
Rise from the depths of the earth.
Appears slowly at the forest edge.

lines.zh: 在岩石缝隙中慢慢爬出。
lines.en: Crawl out of the rock crevices.
Peeks out of the tree洞 slowly.

lines.zh: 受伤了，真扎心，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: This hurts — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 从浮空岛边缘滑下去，摔得不轻。
lines.en: I slipped off the island's edge and landed hard.

lines.zh: 这刺痛着呢，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: It stings — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 伤口好痛啊，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That hurts — and the lightning makes it worse.
